name: Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A.
summary: Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides a range of banking services for individual and corporate clients in Poland and internationally. The company operates in two segments, the Institutional Bank and Consumer Bank.
